caption: The drawing is depicted on an oval plate and portrays a large, rectangular chateau-like building with multiple pointed towers and flags. The main structure is surrounded by tall trees, including evergreens and weeping willows, and the sky above is filled with clouds. In the foreground, there is an open grassy area with a winding path. Three human figures, two adults and one child, are walking along the path towards the building. Close to them is a dog lying on the grass. The rim of the plate features a dense border of grape clusters, grape leaves, and various flowers, forming a decorative frame around the central scene. The image is rendered in monochrome, with varying shades of gray, black, and white used to create detail and contrast in the composition.
title: Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
